2. Parties to the appeal are referred with their ranks as assigned in the Trial Court for the sake of convenience.

3. The factual matrix leading to the case of prosecution can be stated in nutshell to the effect that the daughter of the complainant Savitha was given in marriage to accused No.1, accused No.3 and 4 are the parents of accused No.1 and accused No.5 and 6 are the brother of accused No.1.
One month after the marriage, the daughter of complainant went to the house of accused No.1 for leading marital life.
At the time of marriage, one and half acres of land as agreed before elders was given to accused No.1.
Upto three months of marriage, the daughter of complainant used to inform that she is leading happy married life.

However, thereafter accused No.1 at the CRL.A No.100102 OF 2014 instigation of accused Nos. 3 to 6 used to pick up quarrel with Savitha for every small mistake and abused her in filthy language, as a result she was subjected to mental and physical cruelty and she used to inform the same to her father.

The daughter of complainant has also informed to her father that accused No.1 is insisting that, records of land should be entered only in his name and not in the joint name of accused No.1 and deceased Savitha.
Accused were also insisting to get the gold ornaments called 'Bugudi' which she was wearing at the time of marriage.

The father of deceased Savitha and mother Jayamma, along with Naganagouda and Shivappa with elders went to the house of accused No.1 and advised not to ill-treat the daughter of the complainant Savitha and the ornament Bugudi was not belonged to Savitha and the same belongs to Mahadevamma which has been returned to her after the marriage.
However, on 31.10.2005, while the father of Savitha was going to his land, one Basavareddy and Veerappa informed him that his daughter died due to burn injuries.
Complainant rushed to the CRL.A No.100102 OF 2014 house of the accused and found the dead body of his daughter lying in another portion of the house which was burnt from head to foot.
There was kerosene can of about 20 litres, only about four litres kerosene was left in the can and match box was also lying near the spot.
On enquiry, accused have not revealed anything as to how Savitha died in the house.
Complainant alleged that his daughter Savitha committed suicide due to accused insisting to bring gold ornaments, plot and the land be recorded in the name of accused No.1.
On these allegations made in the complaint, the investigating officer on completion of investigation filed charge sheet.
4. In the charge sheet accused No.2 was given up as there are no material evidence against him who is the grand father of accused No.1.

Abetment of a thing:- A person abets the doing of a thing, who - First - Instigates any person to do that thing ; or Secondly - Engages with one or more other person or persons in any conspiracy for the doing of that thing, if an act or illegal omission takes place in pursuance of that conspiracy, and in order to the doing of that thing; or Thirdly - Intentionally aids,
